question:
In Arc 8, Olbart said that he “doesn’t like Halibel because he’s stronger than him,” but had Olbart and Halibel actually met before?
(Note: “That guy’s the only Shinobi in this world who’s stronger than me, so I seriously hate him.”)
answer:
There have been a lot of questions about Olbart (laughs).

They have met. It wasn't during Abel's era, but during the era of the previous Emperor, Dracoyes. Olbart encountered Halibel when he went to meddle with the Kararagi City-States. That Olbart came back half-dead (after being beaten by Halibel), so even the Empire was scared.

Olbart is actually quite ambitious, but his dreams kept changing: “I couldn't become the strongest in the Vollachian Empire because Cecilus and Arakiya are around.” → “Then I'll aim to become the strongest Shinobi.” → “But Halibel is around, so I couldn't become the strongest Shinobi either.” → “While all that was happening, the ‘Great Disaster’ started.” → “Then, before I die, I might as well become a hero who conquers the country.”

He's an old man, but he's not rigid-minded. He threw away stubbornness and became almost excessively flexible.
